title: Bowl of Indulgent Mozzarella Enchiladas
description: A rich, cheesy twist on traditional enchiladas, served with a side of fresh cilantro and a warm flour tortilla.
instructions: Warm the tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the middle eastern spices and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the enchilada sauce and bring to a simmer. Reduce heat to low.
To assemble the enchiladas, lay a tortilla flat and sprinkle with cheese.
Roll the tortilla up and place seam-side down in the skillet.
Repeat with the remaining tortillas and cheese.
Cover the skillet with a lid and cook for 5-7 minutes, until the cheese is melted and the tortillas are tender.
Transfer the skillet to the oven and bake for an additional 5-7 minutes, until the cheese is bubbly and golden brown.
Remove from the oven and sprinkle with cilantro. Serve immediately in a bowl.
